summary: iter319 review — Public Product Sales, JE lifecycle on payment_status toggle, dead-endpoint repairs (customers/statements/reminders/resources/COA seed) and campus-reports removal. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass. All the audit request items verified end-to-end via API: (1) product `sell_online` gating — hidden until ticked, appears in /api/public/products with name/price/currency/stock/country when ticked, ?country=UG filter honoured; (2) POST /api/public/orders (NO auth) succeeds — server-side re-pricing IGNORES the tampered `price:1` payload and charges the real 25,000 (`total` in response equals 25000); missing name/email → 400, empty basket → 400, non-sell_online product → 400, quantity 9999 → 409; (3) side-effects: stock decrements, sale surfaces in staff /api/sales with channel='online', cashier='Website order', payment_status='pending', and idempotency_key=`sale:{id}` has ZERO live journal entries until paid; (4) accounting hole fixed — PUT /api/sales/{id}/payment-status='paid' posts exactly one balanced JE (D=C=25000, credit account 4100 Sales Revenue), a SECOND `paid` call is idempotent (still 1 live JE), and toggling back to 'pending' reverses it (0 live JEs); (5) Customers CRUD (list, POST, GET-with-purchases, PUT, DELETE, /purchases) all 200; (6) Customer Statements JSON endpoint, schedule list, schedule save all 200; (7) POST /api/payment-reminders/send no longer 404s (correctly returns 400 with a helpful validation message); (8) GET /api/resources/{id} returns the single resource; (9) POST /api/finance/chart-of-accounts/seed is idempotent and returns an insert count; (10) /api/campus-reports and related paths return 404 (removed); (11) Regression: POS cash sale still posts one balanced JE at create time AND decrements stock; store-settings GET works. Frontend UI: login works, campus-reports UI route correctly falls through to /login (not routable), sidebar has NO 'Campus Reports' entry, Sales → Products → Edit product exposes data-testid='product-sell-online-checkbox' + 'product-sell-online-row', Customer Statements page loads with zero pageerror events (pre-existing p>div hydration warning from iter316 still fires), and /public-bookings Shop tab renders the published Gala Ticket at UGX 25,000 with '102 left' and 'Add to Cart' button when sell_online=true.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/public_shop.py: server-side re-pricing is defensive and correct — the basket dict's `price` is never read; `price = float(prod.get('price') or 0)` from the DB is what totals. Verified via test with `price:1` for a 25,000 product → charged 25,000.

routers/sales.py::update_sale_payment_status: reversal path finds prior JE by `idempotency_key='sale:{id}'` and calls `reverse_journal_entry`. Idempotency guaranteed by `post_sale` also using the same key — a second `paid` call finds the existing live JE and no-ops. This is the correct fix for the accounting hole.

routers/public_shop.py: `_country_of_location` walks parent locations to resolve country — nice touch since sub-locations often don't carry a country. Consider memoising across requests if this endpoint gets hot; currently in-request cache only.

routers/public_shop.py: online orders are re-created with a synthetic `public_web` user having role='system'. `create_sale` inside `sales.py` uses `get_current_user['id']`, so this synthetic user must always carry an `id`. Currently hardcoded — safe. Consider extracting the string into a constant.

routers/customers.py DELETE customer does not cascade to associated sales or unset `customer_id` on prior sales — this may orphan `customer_id` refs. Non-blocking (sales still show up under the name), but worth calling out.

routers/statements.py `/customer-statements/{customer_id_or_name}` defaults `format='pdf'` — a GET with no format returns a PDF stream; frontend must always pass `?format=json` for the page render. Verified the page loads without errors so it does.
routers/statements.py `send_payment_reminder`: if no email is on file AND no `to_email` is supplied, raises 400 with a WhatsApp-deep-link hint; helpful.

backend/tests/test_iter319_public_shop_and_repairs.py cleanup fixture ordering matters — must delete sales (which restores stock) BEFORE resetting product `stock` to 97, or the restore adds back on top of the reset. Fixed in the committed file.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 spot-checked flows verified (login, /campus-reports fall-through, sidebar has no Campus Reports entry, /sales Products tab sell-online checkbox+row, /customer-statements page load, /public-bookings Shop tab renders published product with price/stock/Add-to-Cart)

seed_data_creation: All TEST_-prefixed sales, customers, and statement schedules created during the run were deleted by the pytest autouse cleanup fixture. Gala Ticket (prod_1543e921) restored to stock=97, sell_online=false (verified via /api/products at end). No stray tenant data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct finance journal endpoint is /api/finance/journal (NOT /api/finance/journal-entries — that path 404s). ProductsPage lives at /sales; unknown routes fall through to /login (App.js catch-all). Public bookings route is /public-bookings (with hyphen, not slash). To exercise the Shop tab in Playwright the location filter overlay must be dismissed first — using page.get_by_role('tab', name='Shop').click(force=True) after a small wait works; a raw JS `.click()` dispatch also works but changing the active tab requires the Radix internal handlers so use Playwright's click. Product single-GET /api/products/{id} appears to return most fields as null in some code paths — use the list endpoint /api/products and filter by id for reliable state checks. Member document upload/view/archive flow was NOT exercised through the UI in this run (per agent-to-agent note it was untested at start; the tenant still has 0 documents and I didn't want to leave upload artefacts on a live tenant — main agent has already curl-verified the backend endpoints). If retesting, upload a small file via POST /api/documents (multipart), verify view via GET /api/documents/{id}/file, archive via DELETE /api/documents/{id}, then hard-delete the row afterward.
rca of the issue: N/A — everything the review requested backend-side works. The one accounting hole (`update_sale_payment_status` never posting a JE for non-cash sales) was the RCA of the pre-iter319 bug; it is now fixed by posting on 'paid' and reversing via `reverse_journal_entry` on 'pending', both keyed by idempotency_key='sale:{id}' so double-post is impossible. Verified end-to-end.
